name: @threadforge/browser-extension
description: Opt-in local browser chat telemetry for Claude.ai and ChatGPT Web.

scripts.package:chromium: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts/chromium --filename threadforge-browser-chromium.zip --no-input --no-config-discovery --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist-firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts/firefox --filename threadforge-browser-firefox.zip --no-input --no-config-discovery --overwrite-dest
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist-firefox --warnings-as-errors
